name: Parking and Traffic Commission Meeting
agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  PARKING AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION (PTC)
  One West Manchester Blvd., Inglewood, CA 90301
  City Hall Lobby Community Room A
  Wednesday, October 30, 2024 at 7:00pm

  OCTOBER AGENDA

Members
Barbara Hibler, Chairperson  Peter Puglese, City Traffic Engineer
Richard Galindo, District 1  Diana Maximo, Parking and Traffic Department
Kip Rudd, District 2  William Thompson, Parking and Traffic Department
Brett C.S. Roberts, District 3  Lieutenant David Salcedo, Police Department
Lois Hale, District 4
Destinee Wesley, Secretary

Rules of Decorum
https://www.cityofinglewood.org/DocumentCenter/View/18857/2023-Rules-of-Decorum

A. OPENING CEREMONIES
1. Roll Call

B. PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING AGENDA ITEMS
1. Persons wishing to address the Parking and Traffic Commission on any item on the agenda, other
  than the Public Hearing, may do so at this time.

C. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  1. Approval of the Minutes for the meeting held on September 25, 2024.

D. PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING OTHER MATTERS
1. Persons wishing to address the Parking and Traffic Commission on any matter connected with City
  business not elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

E. CHAIRPERSON AND COMMISSIONERS REMARKS
1. Members of the Parking and Traffic Commission will provide oral reports on any matter they
  consider to be of general interest to the public.

F. ANNOUNCEMENTS
1. The next Parking and Traffic Commission meeting will be held on Wednesday, January 22, 2024
  at 7:00 p.m., First Floor, City Hall Community Room A, Inglewood City Hall One Manchester Blvd.,
  Inglewood, CA 90301.

G. ADJOURNMENT

SEPTEMBER 2024_PTC COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA 5  1
